note: Notices on lakes whose timetable is off from normal, shown on that lake's search on every platform (web, iOS, Android) from `from` to `until` (null = until further notice). Edit here, never in app code; a push to main publishes it to the data bucket. Only what the operator itself announces, with its page as the source; update `updated` whenever the text is checked again. A lake with a change in serviceChanges.json needs a notice that explains it (npm run test:data checks). Remove a notice when the operator returns to normal.

notices.title: Low water: reduced timetable
details: Since 19 October 2026, ZSG has run a low-water timetable on Lake Zurich. No end date has been announced.
Küsnacht and Erlenbach are not served. The Thalwil boat calls at Küsnacht Goldbach instead.

The short lake cruise runs only between Bürkliplatz and Kilchberg. The long lake cruise is a round trip from Bürkliplatz via Horgen or Meilen; Lacus shows only the way out, because the official timetable doesn't have the way back.
For 1 to 12 December, the official timetable doesn't have the low-water times yet, so trips shown for those days may change.
Because of steep ramps, ZSG advises against bringing wheelchairs or pushchairs on its boats.

notices.title: Low water: Niederried not served
details: Because of low water, BLS can't serve the landing stage at Niederried. No end date has been announced, and Lacus shows the boats without the Niederried stop.
The boats run with a smaller vessel, so space is limited and BLS can't guarantee boarding.
At Ringgenberg and Oberried you can only board by stairs, so not with a wheelchair. Boarding at Iseltwald and Bönigen is very steep.
